description: Build the 4-step Macros Wizard UI with react-hook-form + @hookform/resolvers/zod + zod. A single RHF form instance spans all steps so 'Corregir datos' never loses entered data. Per-step validation gating via trigger() on the current step's fields before advancing. Results screen shows calorie target + protein/fat/carbs grams (reusing calculateMacros). Two actions: 'Guardar mis metas' (state-driven success UI, NO console.log) and 'Corregir datos' (return to step 1 keeping all values). Styled with the Tailwind design-system tokens (cream bg, sage/pink accents, translucent card, backdrop-blur, Montserrat/Playfair, hover lift, focus:border sage). Add component/integration tests for navigation + validation gating. Playwright E2E for the happy path if feasible.
steps: Create apps/macros-web/src/features/macros-wizard/wizard.schema.ts: a single zod object schema for all fields (sex, ageYears, weightKg, heightCm, activityLevel) using INPUT_LIMITS from the domain; export WizardValues type and STEP_FIELDS mapping each step index to its field names for per-step trigger().
Create apps/macros-web/src/features/macros-wizard/copy.es.ts with all Spanish UI strings (titles, labels, button text 'Guardar mis metas' / 'Corregir datos', activity labels via ACTIVITY_LABELS_ES).

Create small step components in src/features/macros-wizard/steps/: Step1GenderAge.tsx (<select> gender + number input age), Step2WeightHeight.tsx (weight + height number inputs), Step3Activity.tsx (<select> activity level), Step4Results.tsx (Playfair-serif summary showing calorieTarget + macro grams; two action buttons; success banner state). Each uses RHF register/useFormContext and shows field errors. Keep each file focused (<200 lines).

Create reusable presentational components in src/features/macros-wizard/components/: FormCard.tsx (translucent card + backdrop-blur), FieldLabel/TextField/SelectField with focus:border-sage styling and error display, PrimaryButton/SecondaryButton with transition-transform + hover lift. Pull all colors from Tailwind tokens, no inline hex.

Create src/features/macros-wizard/MacrosWizard.tsx: the container. useForm with zodResolver(wizardSchema), mode onTouched, defaultValues. Manage currentStep in React state (0..3). handleNext calls trigger(STEP_FIELDS[currentStep]); only advance if valid. handleBack decrements. On entering step 4 compute macros via calculateMacros(getValues()). 'Guardar mis metas' sets a saved=true success state (no console). 'Corregir datos' sets currentStep=0 WITHOUT reset (data preserved). Render current step inside FormProvider + FormCard with a step indicator.
Create src/App.tsx rendering <MacrosWizard/> centered on the cream background. Wire into src/main.tsx.

Create integration tests src/features/macros-wizard/__tests__/MacrosWizard.test.tsx (Vitest + RTL + user-event): cannot advance past step 1 with empty/invalid fields (error shown, stays on step 1); full happy path male+female to results showing expected calorie/macro numbers; 'Corregir datos' returns to step 1 with previously entered values still populated; 'Guardar mis metas' shows the success banner and no console.log is used. Also test the TextField/SelectField focus/error rendering.
Create e2e/wizard.spec.ts (Playwright): load the built app, complete all 4 steps, assert results and the save-success state appear; assert 'Corregir datos' preserves inputs.
Run typecheck, lint, unit+integration tests with coverage, and build.
acceptance_criteria: Single RHF form instance spans all 4 steps; 'Corregir datos' preserves entered values (no reset)
Advancing is gated by zod validation per step (trigger on current step fields)
Results screen shows calorie target + protein/fat/carbs grams from calculateMacros
'Guardar mis metas' produces a visual success state with NO console.log (passes ESLint no-console)
All colors/fonts come from Tailwind theme tokens; card has backdrop-blur, 16px radius, translucent bg; buttons have hover lift and inputs focus:border sage
verification: Run `cd apps/macros-web && npm run test:coverage -- --run` and confirm all tests pass with >= 80% coverage
Run `cd apps/macros-web && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run build` and confirm all pass

Run `cd apps/macros-web && npm run test:e2e` (after `npx playwright install chromium`) and confirm the happy-path E2E passes, or record it as skipped if the browser cannot be installed in this environment

Exports WizardValues (z.infer), STEP_FIELDS ([['sex','ageYears'],['weightKg','heightCm'],['activityLevel']]) and empty-string-friendly defaultValues.
- copy.es.ts: frozen Spanish strings (app title/subtitle, per-step title/subtitle, field labels Género/Edad/Peso (kg)/Altura (cm)/Nivel de actividad, gender options Hombre/Mujer, nav Atrás/Siguiente + 'Paso X de 4', results labels Objetivo de calorías/Proteína/Grasa/Carbohidratos + g/kcal units, actions EXACTLY 'Guardar mis metas' and 'Corregir datos', saveSuccess, calculationError). Activity labels reuse ACTIVITY_LABELS_ES.
- components/: FormCard.tsx (bg-card, backdrop-blur, rounded-card, border-cardBorder, shadow, padding), TextField.tsx + SelectField.tsx (RHF register, focus:border-sage focus:outline-none focus:ring, aria-invalid + role=alert error text, inputMode numeric/decimal), Button.tsx (PrimaryButton bg-sage text-white / SecondaryButton border-pink; both transition-transform duration-150 hover:-translate-y-0.5).
- steps/: Step1GenderAge (SelectField gender + TextField age), Step2WeightHeight (two TextFields), Step3Activity (SelectField using ACTIVITY_LABELS_ES), Step4Results (font-serif calorie heading, three macro rows with grams/kcal/percent, PRIMARY 'Guardar mis metas' + SECONDARY 'Corregir datos', role=status success banner when saved).
- MacrosWizard.tsx: useForm<WizardValues> with zodResolver(wizardSchema), mode onTouched, defaultValues cast to DefaultValues. currentStep useState 0..3; handleNext awaits trigger(STEP_FIELDS[step]) and only advances when valid; handleBack decrements; handleEdit sets saved=false + currentStep=0 WITHOUT reset (data preserved). Results computed with try/catch: getValues() returns raw strings so values are wizardSchema.parse()'d (coercion) before calculateMacros — fallback to a role=alert error message if it throws. FormProvider wraps steps inside FormCard; step indicator 'Paso X de 4'; Atrás disabled on step 0; nav hidden on results step.
- App.tsx: renders <MacrosWizard/> centered on min-h-screen bg-cream flex items-center justify-center p-4 (main.tsx already mounts App).
- Tests: __tests__/MacrosWizard.test.tsx (7 tests: validation gating on empty + invalid age staying on step 1; male happy path asserting calorieTarget+protein grams vs calculateMacros; female happy path (light) asserting carbs grams; 'Corregir datos' returns to step 1 with age/género/peso/altura values preserved; 'Guardar mis metas' shows role=status banner and console.log spy NOT called; back navigation). __tests__/fields.test.tsx (6 tests: TextField/SelectField focus:border-sage class + aria-invalid + error role=alert; Primary/Secondary button token classes + hover lift + disabled). App.test.tsx updated to assert the wizard renders on step 1 (old 'Calculadora de Macros' heading assertion no longer applies). e2e smoke.spec.ts updated to the step-1 wizard; e2e/wizard.spec.ts added (full 4-step happy path + save success + edit preserves inputs).
